title: OpenDiffraction: Synthetic CDI Patterns
subtitle: Physics-based coherent diffraction images with ground truth and benchmarks
description:
# OpenDiffraction: Physics-Based Synthetic Coherent Diffraction Imaging Dataset

**Creator & Principal Maintainer**: [Muhammad Kamal](https://github.com/KindlyGentleman) (GitHub: `@KindlyGentleman`, Kaggle: `@hamadmuhammadkamal`)
**GitHub Repository**: [https://github.com/KindlyGentleman/opendiffraction](https://github.com/KindlyGentleman/opendiffraction)
**Foundational Reference Paper**: Lee et al. (2025), *Deep-learning real-time phase retrieval of imperfect diffraction patterns from X-ray free-electron lasers*, npj Computational Materials 11, 68. DOI: [10.1038/s41524-025-01569-7](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41524-025-01569-7)

---

## Important Benchmark Scope Notice

**48-Sample Quick-Release Benchmark Scope**:
The published Kaggle release contains **exactly 48 curated samples** (1 per physical variation profile `V01` through `V48`: 35 train, 5 validation, 3 test, 5 test_ood).

**48 samples are strictly insufficient for training supervised deep neural networks from scratch.**

This benchmark is specifically designed for:
1. Rapid evaluation and algorithmic verification of classical phase retrieval iterators (ER, HIO, Shrinkwrap, RAAR).
2. Zero-shot and fine-tuning testing of pre-trained deep phase retrieval models.
3. Out-of-distribution (OOD) stress testing across partial spatial coherence, beam stop geometries, and complex-phase objects.

To generate large-scale training volumes ($10^4$ to $10^5$ samples) for training neural networks from scratch, install and run the generator from GitHub:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/KindlyGentleman/opendiffraction.git
cd opendiffraction
pip install -e .
python -m opendiffraction generate --preset full --samples 10000 --output ./my_full_dataset
```

---

## Data Provenance & Physical Forward Models

- **Origin**: Procedurally simulated from first-principles Fourier optics in Python.
- **Forward Physics (F1 - F6)**: Implements Fraunhofer far-field propagation (F1), corrected Gaussian Schell-model partial spatial coherence (F2), thin-specimen probe wavefront transmission (F3), Fresnel near-field propagation (F4), polychromatic pink-beam spectral summation (F5), and 3D particle Euler rotation Born projections (F6).
- **Detector Imperfections**: Mixed Poisson shot noise ($10^3$ to $10^8$ photons), additive Gaussian electronics readout noise (FWHM 1.0 count, $\sigma=0.425$), direct-beam central beam stops (16x16 square, circular, cross), detector module gaps, dead pixel clusters, and ADC saturation.
- **Downstream Compatibility**: Turnkey compatible with `deeppr.CustomDataset` from Deep Phase Retrieval (DPR) while providing unscaled physical ground truth and uncorrupted ideal intensities.

---

## Dataset Structure & Splits

- `metadata.csv`: Master tabular index of all 48 diffraction patterns with physical parameters, forward models, noise levels, and partition splits.
- `opendiffraction_benchmark.cxi`: Gold-standard Coherent X-ray Imaging (CXI) file compliant with CXIDB specifications.
- `data/train_000.h5`: Primary training split (35 patterns, 72.9%) spanning biological, nanomaterial, and optical phantoms.
- `data/valid_000.h5`: Validation split (5 patterns, 10.4%) for checkpoint selection (V01, V06, V09, V20, V39).
- `data/test_000.h5`: In-distribution test split (3 patterns, 6.3%) for standardized benchmark evaluation (V18, V19, V32).
- `data/test_ood_000.h5`: Out-of-distribution stress test split (5 patterns, 10.4%) quarantined exclusively for OOD evaluation (V43, V44, V45, V46, V48).

---

fields.name: source_object_id
fields.description: Identifier of the underlying ground-truth specimen morphology.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: Variation group identifier grouping related parameter sweeps.

fields.name: split
fields.description: Dataset partition split: train, valid, test, or test_ood.

fields.name: variation_family
fields.description: Variation family code (V01 through V48) designating parameter configuration.

fields.name: object_family
fields.description: Morphological category of specimen (Biological, Nanomaterials, Optical, etc.).

fields.name: density_type
fields.description: Forward simulation optical model: F1 through F6.

fields.name: photon_budget
fields.description: Total incident photon count before detector Poisson shot noise sampling.

fields.name: coherence_length
fields.description: Spatial coherence length parameter in detector pixel units.

fields.name: readout_noise_std
fields.description: Standard deviation of additive Gaussian electronic detector readout noise.

fields.name: beam_stop_geometry
fields.description: Geometry of central direct-beam blocker mask (e.g., 16x16 square, circular, cross).

fields.name: missing_pixel_fraction
fields.description: Fraction of detector pixels missing due to beamstop, module gaps, and defect mask.

fields.name: detector_saturation_threshold
fields.description: Maximum photon count capacity before detector well saturation.

fields.name: beam_center_offset
fields.description: Subpixel coordinate shift (dx, dy) of incident beam center relative to detector origin.

fields.name: random_seed
fields.description: Deterministic pseudo-random generator seed for exact numerical reproducibility.

fields.name: shard_name
fields.description: Name of the target HDF5 container shard containing array data (e.g., train_000.h5).

fields.name: row_index
fields.description: Zero-based row index within the HDF5 shard container.

fields.name: model_compatibility
fields.description: Downstream benchmark model target compatibility label.

resources.description: Gold-standard Coherent X-ray Imaging (CXI) file compliant with CXIDB specifications containing instrument geometry, source properties, detector masks, and 512x512 diffraction patterns.
Primary training HDF5 shard (35 patterns) containing measured intensities (512x512), binary detector masks (512x512), and ground truth objects (64x64).
Validation HDF5 shard (5 patterns) for hyperparameter tuning, model checkpointing, and validation metrics.
In-distribution test HDF5 shard (3 patterns) for standardized evaluation of phase retrieval and inverse models.
Out-of-distribution stress testing HDF5 shard (5 patterns) with extreme photon starvation, heavy occlusion, and severe partial coherence.
Dataset overview, directory structure, physical model descriptions, quickstart Python code, and academic citation guide.
Standardized ML dataset card documenting dataset summary, intended use, limitations, bias analysis, and ethical considerations.
Gebru et al. standard datasheet covering motivation, composition, collection process, preprocessing, uses, and distribution.
Citation File Format specification providing BibTeX and APA citations for academic attribution.
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) open science license terms for data and documentation.
